stem:
Imran says the shop is 200 m away.

What must he have used to make that a position?

options.text: No reference; 200 m is just a number in the air.
A reference point, such as the school gate, from which the 200 m is taken.
Only the colour of the shop sign.
A clock, because position is time.

teacher.key_rationale: A distance that locates something needs a named reference. Colour and time are not that reference.
